_meta.description: Color palette lookup table for rangroop Phase 2. Keys are 'skin_type|undertone' matching Phase 1's exact output categories.
_meta.source_basis: Adapted from published seasonal color analysis (12-season system) and general colorist principles.
_meta.verification_note: First-draft starting point. Cross-check against St Andrews reference dataset and real user feedback before treating as final.

Very Light|Warm.explanation: Very light warm skin can look washed out in stark cool colors. Soft golds, peach, and warm caramel tones bring natural warmth without overpowering fair skin.

Very Light|Cool.explanation: Very light cool skin pairs beautifully with icy pastels, true blues, and clear pinks.

Very Light|Neutral.explanation: Neutral undertones have flexibility with both warm and cool families.

Very Light|Olive.explanation: Olive undertone in fair skin suits muted earthy greens and warm neutrals.

Light|Warm.explanation: Light warm skin glows with amber, terracotta, and honey tones.

Light|Cool.explanation: Light cool skin suits clear, saturated cool colors well.

Light|Neutral.explanation: Neutral undertone at this depth handles a wide range of muted tones well.

Light|Olive.explanation: Olive-toned light skin pairs well with warm earth tones and muted greens.

Intermediate|Warm.explanation: Medium warm skin carries rich, earthy warm tones exceptionally well.

Intermediate|Cool.explanation: Medium cool skin suits jewel tones that complement the cool undercast.

Intermediate|Neutral.explanation: Neutral medium tones handle both warm and cool families in moderation.

Intermediate|Olive.explanation: Olive medium skin pairs naturally with warm browns and forest greens.

Tan|Warm.explanation: Tan warm skin looks radiant in deep golds, rust, and terracotta.

Tan|Cool.explanation: Tan cool skin suits rich jewel tones that contrast pleasantly with the cool undercast.

Tan|Neutral.explanation: Neutral tan skin has flexibility across mid-tone, moderately saturated colors.

Tan|Olive.explanation: Olive tan skin pairs beautifully with warm, earthy, muted greens and browns.

Dark|Warm.explanation: Dark warm skin carries bold, saturated warm colors beautifully.

Dark|Cool.explanation: Dark cool skin suits vivid jewel tones exceptionally.

Dark|Neutral.explanation: Neutral dark skin handles bold colors from both warm and cool families well.

Dark|Olive.explanation: Olive-toned dark skin pairs richly with deep warm earth tones and forest greens.

Very Dark|Warm.explanation: Very dark warm skin carries the boldest, most saturated warm colors stunningly.

Very Dark|Cool.explanation: Very dark cool skin suits the most vivid jewel tones for maximum striking contrast.

Very Dark|Neutral.explanation: Neutral very dark skin carries bold colors from either family.

Very Dark|Olive.explanation: Olive very dark skin pairs powerfully with deep warm earth tones.
